channel.title: The Modern Schoolhouse
channel.description: A K-12 education blog on school choice, teaching trends, and student success

item.title: The Hidden College-Prep Power of Competitive Clubs
item.description: Debate, robotics, and science fair aren't just trophies. Research shows competitive extracurriculars close the college-readiness gap for underserved K-12 students.

item.title: Is Your Child's School Built for How They Actually Learn?
item.description: The best school isn't the highest-ranked—it's the one built for your child's learner profile. Here's why right-fit matching is reshaping school choice in 2025.

item.title: History Class Makes Better Readers: Here's the Research
item.description: Research shows more social studies time—not more ELA—boosts reading scores. Here's what the evidence says and what it means for school choice families.

item.title: Student Mental Health and the School Choice Decision
item.description: The student mental health crisis is reshaping why families choose charter schools. Here's what the research says about school size, belonging, and wellbeing.

item.title: Mastery Over Minutes: The Rise of Competency-Based Learning
item.description: All 50 states now allow competency-based learning. Here's what that means for students, families, and the schools built to make it work.

item.title: Beyond Test Scores: Why Schools Must Teach Kids to Lead Themselves
item.description: Research confirms that problem-solving, goal-setting, and self-regulation predict student success as powerfully as academics. Here's what that means for K-12 schools.

item.title: The Attendance Crisis Schools Can't Ignore in 2025
item.description: Chronic absenteeism still affects nearly 1 in 4 students. Here's how school choice and charter schools are helping turn the tide.

item.title: What Makes Charter Schools Work? The Research
item.description: The latest research reveals why high-performing charter schools get results — and what specific practices separate them from those that don't deliver.

item.description: New 2025 surveys reveal what parents actually prioritize when switching schools—and it's not rankings or test scores. Here's what the data shows.

item.description: Dual enrollment is booming—but equity gaps persist. Here's how charter high schools are using dual credit to open college doors for underserved students.

item.description: 74% of microschools serve neurodiverse students. Here's why small, integrated learning settings are surging — and how ESA funding is making them accessible.

item.description: Critical thinking, collaboration, communication, creativity—how skills-first charter schools are reshaping K-12 education and what families need to know.

item.description: New research reveals why most high-dosage tutoring programs underperform—and the specific design choices that make tutoring actually move the needle.

item.title: Beyond College: Why High School Needs a Bigger Mission
item.description: With college confidence at historic lows, K-12 schools are rethinking their purpose. Here's what the data shows—and what schools getting it right look like.

item.description: More families are choosing charter and online schools for one underrated reason: a teacher who actually knows their child. Here's the research behind why it matters.

item.description: More online charter schools lead with STEM and college-prep rigor. Here's what that means for families choosing K-12 education in 2025.

item.description: Microschool enrollment is surging in 2025. Here's what's driving families to tiny schools, how they differ from charters, and what it means for K-12 choice.

item.description: Hybrid and independent-study charter schools are growing fast. Here's what the 2025 data says about why families are choosing flex models—and how students perform.

item.description: Charter schools trade autonomy for accountability. Here's what that bargain actually means, what the research shows, and what parents should ask before enrolling.

item.description: Charter schools lose teachers at higher rates than traditional public schools. Here's what the data shows—and what smart charter leaders do differently to retain great educators.
